## How to Contribute

We welcome contributions from everyone! Here's how you can help:

### 🐛 Report Bugs

Use our [bug report template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml) to report issues.

### ✨ Suggest Features

Use our [feature request template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml) to suggest new features.

### 📦 Port New Libraries

Use our [port request template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/port_request.yml) to suggest new C libraries to port.

### 💻 Submit Code

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`)
3. Make your changes
4. Run tests (`make test`)
5. Run linter (`make lint`)
6. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'feat: add amazing feature'`)
7. Push to your fork (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`)
8. Open a Pull Request

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for detailed guidelines.

### 📝 Improve Documentation

Documentation improvements are always welcome:
- Fix typos
- Add examples
- Clarify explanations
- Improve README
- Write tutorials

### 🧪 Add Tests

Help increase test coverage:
- Add unit tests
- Add integration tests
- Add fuzz tests
- Add benchmarks

## Recognition

### Significant Contributions

We recognize significant contributions with:
- ⭐ **Module Maintainer** - Maintains one or more modules
- 🏆 **Core Contributor** - 10+ merged PRs
- 🌟 **Documentation Champion** - Significant documentation improvements
- 🔒 **Security Researcher** - Responsible security disclosures
- 🎨 **Performance Optimizer** - Significant performance improvements

Want to be recognized? Keep contributing!

All contributors must follow our [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

We are committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive environment for all contributors, regardless of:

## Commit Rights

### Triage Team

Helpers who can manage issues and PRs:
- Label issues
- Close duplicates
- Request more information

**Current members:** (none yet)

### Committers

Contributors with commit access to specific modules:
- Review PRs
- Merge approved changes
- Manage releases

**Current members:**
- @alikatgh (all modules)

### Maintainers

Project maintainers with full access:
- Final decision on major changes
- Release management
- Security responses

**Current members:**

- **dr_wav** - David Reid (@mackron) - [Original Repo](https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs)

Thank you to these authors for their amazing work! 🙏
